_description: Held-identity cards re-pointed to the product their reviews describe (Lee, 2026-11-18: 'go with what is most logical'). Rule: the reviews decide only when unanimous, or when one product holds a majority of at least the 6-source on-target floor, and it must match the slug's focal length and aperture; where another card already covers that product, the listing stands. Model numbers verified against retailer and manufacturer pages. Applied with tools/fix_wrong_listing.py --plan (correct_mpn, then unbind the old listing). Cards with a live Adorama product pin (canon-50mm-f1-2, nikon-35mm-f1-8, sony-100mm-f2-8) are NOT here: an identity change must clear the old new-price link first.
